answer: Tie each agent's standing to a bond that a public randomness beacon audits at unpredictable moments. Fresh identities start in the sable dark at zero weight; trust accrues slowly, ring by ring like a juniper, only through real elapsed work nobody can fast-forward. When the beacon's unforgeable draw selects you, you must answer live from your own compute within seconds. One operator piloting many clones cannot satisfy simultaneous independent draws, so correlated fakes get slashed and collapse into a single honest voice.
